name: baseline-and-acceptance
body:
Historical / motivational context ONLY — these are not acceptance bounds and must not be asserted or required by any test. Scanner optimisation exists because a very large repository's full scan and DB rebuild are expensive (an hour-plus full scan on the motivating large-repo case), so re-scans after small edits must be cheap. The large-repo cost is why the optimisation exists; it is not a measurement input.

Acceptance is self-contained (requirements.requirement.incremental-acceptance-targets): it is exercised on synthetic scratch fixtures built under the system temp dir, with no external workload checkout and no recorded external baseline. Every acceptance bound is relative to a full scan of the same fixture in the same run, measured via the per-phase timing report.
